#bot.Expression.Happy
Lady Annalie: Oh! Hi you two!
You: What’s up Annalie?
Lady Annalie: All good. I’m having fun preparing for Halloween. How do you like my costume?
Bot: You look great in this witch costume!
Lady Annalie: It’s not only a witch costume, but also a costume of my favorite character from a certain video game franchise.
Lady Annalie: It’s more of a cosplay, really.
Bot: You sure know your stuff.
Lady Annalie: These decorations are pretty neat too, right? I spent way too much time setting this all up.
You: You must really like halloween. 
Lady Annalie: Of course I do! For someone interested in clothes there’s no better time all year around than a holiday on which people dress up in all sorts of costumes!
Lady Annalie: By the way. I might have bought a little too many Halloween gadgets and I’m stuck here selling them.
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: It would mean a lot for you two to take a look and maybe choose something for yourselves.
You: Sure, why not.
